name: Bayesian Finemapping With Deep Vi
description: Performs Bayesian fine-mapping from GWAS summary statistics using deep variational inference to compute posterior inclusion probabilities and credible sets for putative causal variants.
detailed_description: Performs Bayesian fine-mapping from GWAS summary statistics using deep variational inference to compute posterior inclusion probabilities and credible sets for putative causal variants.
when_to_use: When you need bayesian finemapping with deep vi analysis

parameters.gwas_summary_path: [Required] Path to CSV or TSV file containing GWAS summary statistics with variant_id, effect_size, pvalue, and optional se columns (str)
parameters.ld_matrix: [Required] Linkage disequilibrium matrix with pairwise correlations between variants (numpy.ndarray)
parameters.n_iterations: [Optional] Number of training iterations for the variational inference algorithm (default: 5000)
parameters.learning_rate: [Optional] Learning rate for the optimization algorithm (default: 0.01)
parameters.hidden_dim: [Optional] Hidden dimension size for the neural network (default: 64)
parameters.credible_threshold: [Optional] Threshold for defining the credible set (e.g., 0.95 for a 95% credible set) (default: 0.95)
